account.title: Create your account
account.step1: Choose Sign up from the header or home page.
account.step2: Enter your email and password, then confirm your account.
account.step3: Verify your email before revealing contact details on listings.

findJobs.title: Find work near you
findJobs.step1: Open Find work from the navigation menu.
findJobs.step2: Enter a city or postcode, choose a role, and set a search radius.
findJobs.step3: Switch between Map and List views to browse matching jobs.
findJobs.step4: Open a job to read the full description and reveal employer contact details.

workerProfile.title: Set up your worker profile
workerProfile.step1: Subscribe to a Basic or Advanced plan from Billing.
workerProfile.step2: Open My profile and complete your skills, availability, and location.
workerProfile.step3: Publish your profile so employers can find you in worker search.

hireWorkers.title: Find and contact workers
hireWorkers.step1: Open Hire from the navigation menu.
hireWorkers.step2: Filter by location, role, and desired job type.
hireWorkers.step3: View a worker profile and reveal contact details with a Basic or Advanced plan.

postJobs.title: Post and manage jobs
postJobs.step1: Subscribe to the Advanced plan from Billing.
postJobs.step2: Open My jobs and create a new listing with title, description, and location.
postJobs.step3: Publish the job so workers can find it on the map and in search results.

billing.title: Manage your plan
billing.step1: Open Pricing or Billing from the navigation menu to compare Free, Worker, and Employer plans.
billing.step2: Worker (£10/year or £1/month) unlocks worker profiles, contact reveals, and education guides; Employer (£100/year or £10/month) adds job posting.
billing.step3: Use Manage billing to update payment details or change your subscription.

whatIsAga.question: What is AGA?
whatIsAga.answer: AGA is a UK job marketplace where workers find local roles and employers hire nearby talent. Search on a map, manage profiles, and connect when both sides are ready.

freeSearch.question: Can I search without a paid plan?
freeSearch.answer: Yes. Browsing jobs and workers on the map is free. A Worker or Employer plan is required to reveal contact details, create a worker profile, or access education guides. Posting jobs requires Employer.

plans.question: What is the difference between the plans?
plans.answer: Free lets you search the map without viewing contact details. Worker (£10/year or £1/month) adds a worker profile, job search with contact reveals, and education guides. Employer (£100/year or £10/month) includes everything in Worker plus posting jobs and full app access.

revealContact.question: How does revealing contact details work?
revealContact.answer: When you reveal contact info on a job or worker profile, phone, email, and LinkedIn (if provided) become visible to you. The other party is notified, and the action is logged for safety.

contactShared.question: Is my contact information shared automatically?
contactShared.answer: No. Your contact details are only shown to someone who has an eligible plan and explicitly reveals them on your listing.

verifyEmail.question: Why do I need to verify my email?
verifyEmail.answer: Email verification helps protect the marketplace. You must verify your address before revealing contact details.

language.question: How do I change the language?
language.answer: Use the Language control in the header to switch between English, Arabic, and Central Kurdish. The site layout adjusts for right-to-left languages automatically.

moreGuides.question: Where can I find more guides?
moreGuides.answer: Visit the Education page for downloadable PDFs and video walkthroughs published by the AGA team.
